Name: Lilly's Ribombee (Pokemon)
Author: Letsgolilly
Description:
Adds Ribombee as a Barn animal.
Ribombee will gather honey and different kinds of Pollen Puffs.
The regular Pollen Puff can be made into a dish.
The other kinds are exclusive to a season and all give a different buff.
Ribombee can be purchased at Marnie.
If you're lucky you might even buy a shiny one. 

You can get Dolls of Ribombee if you download my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29334]Skitty[/url] mod.
